'''Beetleknight''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Donscarab]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Beetleknight, the diamond-armored hero, descends from the sky to take out evil with one punch. Saving lives? Absolutely. Showing off cool moves? That's a priority too."

Beetleknight is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Donned in dazzling armor, the heroic Beetleknight strikes down foes with a single punch. A once-in-a-millennium superhero among the beetle clan."
